name: 1-(2-(4-morpholinyl)ethyl)-3-(1-naphthoyl) indole
summary: JWH-200 (WIN 55,225) is an analgesic chemical from the aminoalkylindole family that acts as a cannabinoid receptor agonist.

pharmacology.text: JWH-200 (WIN 55,225) is an analgesic chemical from the aminoalkylindole family that acts as a cannabinoid receptor agonist.

summaryZh: JWH-200，也稱作WIN 55,225，是一種由約翰·威廉·霍夫曼小組合成的萘甲醯基吲哚類JWH大麻素，分子式C25H24N2O2，可作為鎮痛藥使用。
summaryZhHans: JWH-200，也称作WIN 55,225，是一种由约翰·威廉·霍夫曼小组合成的萘甲酰基吲哚类JWH大麻素，分子式C25H24N2O2，可作为镇痛药使用。

uses.en: It was made for cannabinoid research. It has also turned up in herbal smoking blends sold as synthetic cannabis.
uses.zh: 它原本是為了大麻素研究而製造，也曾出現在以合成大麻名義販售的草本吸食混合物中。
uses.zhHans: 它原本是为了大麻素研究而制造，也曾出现在以合成大麻名义贩售的草本吸食混合物中。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, anxiety, paranoia, vomiting, psychosis and seizures, and some have caused deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳加快、焦慮、妄想、嘔吐、精神病症狀與癲癇發作，部分已造成死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳加快、焦虑、妄想、呕吐、精神病症状与癫痫发作，部分已造成死亡。

fact.en: Its WIN code comes from the drug company Sterling Winthrop, whose chemists found the aminoalkylindole family while working on the painkiller pravadoline. The JWH name was given later by the lab of chemist John W. Huffman.
fact.zh: 它的WIN代號來自Sterling Winthrop藥廠，該公司的化學家在研究止痛藥pravadoline時發現了胺烷基吲哚家族。JWH這個名稱則是後來化學家John W. Huffman的實驗室所取。
fact.zhHans: 它的WIN代号来自Sterling Winthrop药厂，该公司的化学家在研究止痛药pravadoline时发现了胺烷基吲哚家族。JWH这个名称则是后来化学家John W. Huffman的实验室所取。
